parameters.name: Description
parameters.description: The description of the primary/secondary server group.

parameters.name: IncludeListener
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to return information about the associated listeners. Valid values:

*   **true**
*   **false**

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The region ID of the CLB instance.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun slb describe-master-slave-server-groups --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --load-balancer-id lb-bp14zi0n66zpg6o000000 --include-listener false --tag Value=TestValue Key=TestKey --description Group3 --api-version 2014-05-15 --region cn-hangzhou
